uplink.description: fPort 1 standard payload: 25.00 C, 3.60 V, DIN1 asserted
uplink._note: Synthetic, verified against reference/upstream-codec.js parseStandardPayload: temp 12-bit = (bytes[6]&0xf0)>>4=8 | bytes[7]<<4=192 => 200 * 0.125 = 25.0 C (bytes[7] bit7=0 positive); Battery raw = ((bytes[6]&0x0f)=3)<<8 | bytes[5]=132 => 900 * 4 = 3600 mV => 3.6 V; DIN1 = bytes[0] bit0 = 1.

uplink.description: fPort 1 standard payload: negative -10.00 C, 3.60 V
uplink._note: Synthetic, verified against reference parseStandardPayload below-zero branch: temp 12-bit = 0 | (251<<4)&0xfff = 4016; bytes[7] bit7=1 => (4096-4016)*0.125*-1 = -10.0 C; Battery raw = 3<<8|132 = 900 * 4 = 3600 mV => 3.6 V.

uplink.description: heartbeat / non-standard payload fPort is not normalized
uplink._note: fPort 10 is the 1.0 heartbeat payload (no unit-defined temperature); this codec only normalizes the fPort 1 standard measurement payload.
